title: catalyst share status
description: What `catalyst share status --json` prints: the criterion's sharing driver, where its shared copy is, the local changes not yet published and how far it is from the shared copy, when known (catalyst >= 0.90.0 serves it).

location.description: Where the shared copy is; null when not shared.

dirty.description: The criterion's files changed and not yet published.

mode.description: The driver's own detail (git: home, submodule, local).
